jobs.title: Director, Enterprise Security & IT
jobs.description:
**At** **Klue****, We’re Building the Future of Competitive Intelligence**
==========================================================================

**We’re looking for a Security, Compliance \& IT Leader**
=========================================================

As our **Director, Enterprise Security \& IT**, you'll sit at the intersection of security, compliance, and IT operations. You'll be accountable for how Klue protects customer data and how every Kluebee gets equipped to do their best work. Today, these three areas sit under different teams. You'll turn them into one team with one roadmap, working alongside an Engineering org that already builds and runs our product infrastructure.

**Your Mission?** To own the security and compliance posture that our customers, our sales team, and our own people rely on. That covers everything we do: from building the product, to the internal automations, to the tools we use, and how we use AI. You'll set the standard, build the systems and set the rhythm to meet it. And in the process, make the secure way, the easy way.

**What's In It for You?**
-------------------------

  

You won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it. You'll define the operating model, the culture, and the technical direction for a brand\-new function, and shape a small, sharp team of 2 from day one. You'll report directly to the CTO and work closely with the Senior Leadership Team, as well as the Engineering, Product, Sales, and People teams. You'll tackle big questions like how to govern AI agents connected to company systems, and your answers will set policy at Klue. As Klue grows, so do the team and your scope. You have the power to shape what that looks like.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own security posture and incident readiness.** Mature how Klue prevents, detects, and responds to security issues. Design the incident response process and governance, and make sure everyone knows their role before something goes wrong.
* **Run the compliance engine.** Own the annual audit cycle against SOC 2 Type II, NIST CSF, and BSIMM, plus penetration testing, from evidence collection to a successful finish. Build audit methodology and documentation that make reviews faster and less painful for the whole company.
* **Be the security answer for go\-to\-market.** Keep customer questionnaires, external assessments, and audits moving on time. Review and negotiate data protection agreements and security exhibits with customers and vendors so what we sign matches what we do.
* **Govern vendors, data, and privacy.** Run full\-spectrum vendor reviews, including sub\-processor qualification. Own DLP, data retention, and the privacy framework for an international customer base, including data subject access requests.
* **Set the rules for AI and high\-risk access.** Own AI security governance: policies, risk acceptance, data handling, and permissioning for AI tools, agents, and integrations connected to company systems. Define and enforce access governance for high\-risk systems, including admin access reviews, service accounts vs. individual credentials, and controls on sensitive logs and data.
* **Make security engineering's job easier.** Set the security and compliance standard for Engineering's security work. Give the team the tooling, policy, and guidelines to build against, and translate their technical work into terms leadership and customers can act on.
* **Equip and enable every Kluebee.** Own devices, access, and tooling across the full employee lifecycle. Manage the vendors behind our IT stack, set and hit reliability targets (SLOs) for corporate systems, and replace ad hoc fixes with repeatable processes that scale. Partner with People so onboarding and offboarding run smoothly. (Product infrastructure stays with Engineering.)

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* **One team, one roadmap.** Within two quarters, Security, Compliance, and IT operate as one team with a shared roadmap and a regular operating rhythm.
* **Customers get fast, consistent answers.** Questionnaires, audits, and sub\-processor reviews are completed on time and in a repeatable way.
* **AI and access are governed, not improvised.** High\-risk systems and AI tools are covered by clear, documented policy, and admin access reviews are routine, not reactive.
* **Corporate systems are reliable.** You define clear SLOs in your first quarter, and Klue meets or beats them.
* **We're ready when it counts.** Incident response governance is documented and understood, and Engineering's security engineers have the tooling and guidelines to respond fast.
* **Day 1 just works.** Every new Kluebee has working equipment and access on their first day, with no scrambling.
* **The budget is a set of clear choices.** You actively manage the function's budget and make defensible tradeoffs between tooling, vendors, and headcount.
* **You're the default owner.** The CTO and SLT turn to you for security, compliance, and IT. Engineering and GTM teams see you as the partner who makes their job easier, not another layer to work around.

**What You Bring**
------------------

**Must Haves**

* You've run security and compliance at a company handling sensitive customer data. You're comfortable owning DLP, data retention, and privacy frameworks, and you can work through a security questionnaire or audit without panic.
* You've led IT operations for a whole company, covering equipment, access, and tooling.
* You know security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) and global privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA) in depth.
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and building without a playbook.
* You communicate clearly with both technical peers and non\-technical leaders, and can explain a risk to an engineer and to a CEO.
* You've negotiated data protection agreements and security exhibits in vendor and customer contracts.

Scribd, Inc. is on a mission to advance human understanding. Our four products — Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable — help billions of people across the globe move beyond access and into insight, application, and expertise.

**Culture at Scribd, Inc.**
---------------------------


We support a culture where our employees can be real and be bold; where we debate and commit as we embrace plot twists; and where every employee is empowered to take action as we prioritize the customer.


We believe the best work happens when individual flexibility is balanced with meaningful community connection. Scribd Flex empowers employees to choose the workstyle and location that support their best performance, while committing to intentional in\-person moments that strengthen collaboration and culture. Occasional in\-person attendance is required for all Scribd, Inc. employees, regardless of location.


So what are we looking for in new team members? At Scribd, Inc., we hire for “GRIT.” Traditionally defined as the intersection of passion and perseverance toward long\-term goals, GRIT reflects the mindset we expect from every employee. For us, it also serves as a practical framework for how we work: setting and achieving Goals, delivering Results within your role, contributing Innovative ideas and solutions, and strengthening the broader Team through collaboration and attitude.


This posting reflects an approved, open position within the organization.

Data \& Analytics is building the DNA of an AI native Scribd, Inc. Bringing together Analytics Engineering, Data Science, and Data Analytics, D\&A partners across product, technology, content, and the business to scale intelligence, advance understanding, shape strategy, and turn insight into lasting growth across our four brand portfolio.


Making this ambition real at scale starts with Analytics Engineering. The team transforms fragmented data, inconsistent definitions, and dispersed analytical knowledge into trusted, reusable, production quality data foundations and products that enable intelligence to scale across the company.


In partnership with Engineering, Analytics Engineers ensure critical data is captured, centralized, documented, secured, and governed. The team builds canonical datasets, shared metrics, and semantic layers, together with the quality, observability, lineage, and evaluation systems that make these assets trustworthy. On top of this foundation, Analytics Engineers develop AI agents and analytical tools that bring reliable intelligence directly into the decisions and workflows of teams across the company.

**The Role**


We’re hiring for a Director, Analytics Engineering to own scaling data for an AI native Scribd, Inc. You will build, scale, and lead a high performing Analytics Engineering team, turning strong individual contributors into a cohesive and highly effective team. This requires more than hiring and developing exceptional talent. It means establishing an operating model that creates structure without unnecessary bureaucracy, fostering culture and community that balances local priorities with the broader success of the company, and creating the technical foundations and standards of excellence that enable everyone to do their best work.
  

  

Your leadership philosophy is grounded in service. A leader’s role is to provide clarity, create context, remove obstacles, and help others succeed. You will strengthen team dynamics, ensure great work is recognized, create meaningful career pathways, and help individuals navigate obstacles and opportunities throughout their careers. Durable teams are built by distributing ownership, developing leaders, and creating an environment where people feel trusted, supported, and accountable.


Your pragmatic approach keeps the organization moving forward. Rather than waiting for an ideal end state, you will think in sequences and ask, “What is the right next version?” Communication happens early and often because transparency, thoughtful feedback, and visible decision making build trust and help teams move with confidence.


Your strong strategic judgment is paired with enough proximity to the work to guide technical decisions credibly. You will connect analytics engineering investments to company priorities, communicate tradeoffs clearly to senior leaders, and contribute thoughtfully to decisions about data modeling, architecture, governance, quality, tooling, and developer experience.


The transformation happening through AI is an opportunity to expand what talented teams can accomplish. Agentic coding, AI assisted development and analysis, and automated workflows can increase human judgment, creativity, and impact rather than replace them. You approach these technologies with curiosity and pragmatism, applying them where they create clear and measurable value.


Above all, leadership is about building people and strengthening the discipline they share. Success is reflected in a team that grows more capable, confident, connected, and effective because of your leadership.

**The Essentials**

* 10\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, business intelligence engineering or a related discipline, including 5\+ years leading and developing technical teams
* Proven track record of building, scaling, and leading high performing teams, turning strong individual contributors into cohesive and highly effective teams that are valued as strategic partners
* Depth in building governed, canonical data models and semantic layers, giving core business concepts one authoritative, discoverable definition instead of letting teams reconcile competing sources

* Lead our paid media strategy across search, social, retargeting, ABM, programmatic, and other digital channels.
* Own channel mix, budget allocation, forecasting, and optimization based on performance.

**Employment Status:** Permanent Full Time


**Position Status:** This is a Non\-Bargaining Unit position


This posting is for a new vacancy.

**Hours of Work:** Monday to Friday, 35 Hours

**Position Reports to:** Chief Executive Officer

**Salary Range: $**125,000 \- $140,000, commensurate on skills and experience, plus participation in HOOPP and Group Benefits.

**Primary work location:** Oshawa (Hybrid work environment); Staff may be requested to work out of other DCHC’s sites in Pickering, Whitby, Ajax, Oshawa South and Oshawa North (Airport Road) as required.

**Direct Reports**: 5


* Manager
* Quality Improvement Coordinator \- 1
* Health Information Specialist \- 1
* Data Analyst \- 2

 **Organization**


Who We Are: Durham Community Health Centre (DCHC) is a charitable registered organization that provides integrated, accessible, and equitable community\-based primary care, wellness services, and health education for Durham community members facing barriers to health and well\-being.

  

Who We Serve: DCHC offers equity\-focused programs and services for priority populations, including Indigenous peoples, Black communities, 2SLGBTQI\+ community members, newcomers to Canada, seniors, and clients without a family doctor. This approach helps community members access both preventive care and care when they are ill.

  

How We Work: Our interprofessional team includes physicians, nurse practitioners, nurses, counsellors, dietitians, outreach workers, medical secretaries, and administrative staff. Together, we place each client at the centre of care and respond to their needs through integrated clinical care, wellness support, and health education.

  

Why Join Now: This is an exciting time to join DCHC as we advance an energizing path toward greater impact in local health care. Guided by our Strategic Plan, Theory of Change, brand, client stories, and resources, we are diversifying, expanding, and strengthening how we serve the community.

 **Position Overview**


Durham Community Health Center (DCHC) is seeking an exceptional, self\-driven leader to take on the role of Senior Director, Enterprise Performance, Evaluation and Strategic Initiatives. The role demands a leader who thrives in complexity, excels in driving enterprise\-wide performance, and is relentless in the pursuit of excellence.

  

At DCHC we are committed to a collaborative culture where strategic thinking, execution discipline and shared leadership are at the core of everything we do. As a key member of the Executive Leadership Team, the Senior Director will be responsible for aligning enterprise performance, strategic initiatives, and quality improvement with DCHC’s long\-term vision.

  

This role is a unique opportunity for an innovative leader to build high\-impact frameworks for evaluation, decision support, special project execution and quality transformation. The right candidate will be a visionary, a doer and a collaborator; someone who can seamlessly transition between strategy and execution while fostering an organizational culture of continuous improvement and strategic excellence.

 **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


As a member of the Executive Leadership Team and strategic advisor to the CEO, the Senior Director provides enterprise leadership across strategy execution, performance intelligence, transformation, risk, quality, accreditation, and organizational alignment.

  

1\. **Enterprise Strategy \& Execution**

* Translate DCHC’s strategic plan into clear annual priorities, business operating plans, performance measures, and funder accountabilities.
* Lead enterprise strategy execution and monitor progress against strategic commitments, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and long\-term strategic objectives.
* Ensure alignment between Board priorities, CEO direction, ELT accountabilities, resource management, and organizational initiatives execution.

**2\. Enterprise Performance \& Intelligence**

* Establish DCHC’s enterprise performance management framework.
* Develop integrated, real\-time dashboards, scorecards, quality indicators, and performance reporting tools.
* Lead enterprise analytics, program evaluation, KPIs, outcome measurement, governance reporting, and data\-informed decision\-making.
* Provide the CEO and ELT with timely intelligence focusing on trends to support strategic decisions and performance improvement.

**3\. Strategic Initiatives \& Transformation**

* Lead CEO and ELT\-sponsored strategic initiatives, complex enterprise projects, and transformational initiatives that improve service delivery and operational effectiveness.
* Establish clear governance framework, milestones, accountabilities, and measures for all organizational initiatives aligned to DCHC corporate balance scorecard.

**4\. Enterprise Risk, Quality \& Organizational Excellence**

* Lead the enterprise risk management strategy, including proactive risk identification, mitigation, monitoring, annual planning, and reporting.
* Lead DCHC’s enterprise Quality Improvement and accreditation strategy, including organization\-wide QI frameworks, and compliance reporting.
* Integrate quality, risk, performance, evaluation, and continuous improvement into one enterprise framework.
* Strengthen organizational resilience, accountability, and readiness for emerging challenges.

**5\. CEO Advisory \& Enterprise Alignment**

* Serve as a strategic advisor to the Office of the CEO.
* Provide executive analysis, strategic options, decision support, and recommendations that enhance program and organizational effectiveness.
* Lead CEO Office strategic operating plans and priority tracking.
* Identify and resolve cross\-portfolio dependencies, competing priorities, and organizational barriers that could impede enterprise execution.
* Champion One DCHC, One Strategy, One Enterprise.

 **Strategic Mandate**

jobs.title: Vice President, Risk Data Strategy and Transformation
jobs.description:
**Work Location:**

Toronto, Ontario, Canada
**Hours:**

37\.5
**Line of Business:**

Risk Management
**Pay Details:**

$185,000 \- $275,000 CAD
TD is committed to providing fair and equitable compensation opportunities to all colleagues. Growth opportunities and skill development are defining features of the colleague experience at TD. Our compensation policies and practices have been designed to allow colleagues to progress through the salary range over time as they progress in their role. The base pay actually offered may vary based upon the candidate's skills and experience, job\-related knowledge, geographic location, and other specific business and organizational needs.


As a candidate, you are encouraged to ask compensation related questions and have an open dialogue with your recruiter who can provide you more specific details for this role.


**Job Description:**

We are looking for a strategic and collaborative executive to shape and deliver the enterprise Risk Data Strategy. As Vice President, Risk Data Strategy and Transformation, you will lead the roadmap, governance, quality, architecture, and lifecycle management of Risk data products and platforms, building capabilities that strengthen risk management, regulatory compliance, analytics, reporting, and decision\-making.  



  

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Risk Transformation and Enablement, you will work across Risk Management and with enterprise partners to modernize data capabilities, strengthen governance, and enable scalable, transparent, and resilient solutions. This is an opportunity to influence enterprise priorities and advance data\-informed decision\-making in a highly regulated environment.  



  

**Key Accountabilities**

* Set the enterprise Risk Data Strategy, target\-state capabilities, investment priorities, and multi\-year roadmap.
* Lead the governance and lifecycle management of Risk data products and platforms, including ownership, quality, lineage, standards, and controls.
* Shape the evolution of Risk data architecture and integration strategies to support scalable, transparent, and resilient capabilities.
* Translate Risk priorities into practical roadmaps, including the technology, data, governance, and implementation considerations required for delivery.
* Lead portfolio planning and prioritization for Risk data initiatives, balancing strategic value, capacity, dependencies, regulatory expectations, and risk.
* Oversee the funding, delivery, benefits tracking, and value realization of Risk data products and initiatives.
* Establish governance and reporting that give senior leaders clear visibility into progress, outcomes, risks, issues, and decisions.
* Advance data modernization by applying emerging technologies, industry trends, and leading practices where they add value.
* Anticipate and manage delivery risks, resolve obstacles, and bring forward timely recommendations and trade\-offs.
* Build strong partnerships across Risk, Technology, Enterprise Data and Analytics, Finance, Regulatory Reporting, and other shared\-service teams.
* Lead with empathy and transparency, creating an environment where colleagues feel heard, supported, and confident navigating change.
Develop an inclusive, high\-performing environment where different perspectives are valued and teams are empowered to deliver.  
* 

  

**Key Partnerships**

* Risk Management leaders and teams across all Risk pillars.
* Enterprise partners across Risk Technology, Enterprise Data and Analytics, Enterprise Architecture, Finance, Regulatory Reporting, Governance and Control, and shared services.
* Senior executives, governance forums, and program sponsors responsible for strategic prioritization and decision\-making.
Product, platform, architecture, and delivery teams responsible for building and sustaining Risk data capabilities.  
* 

  

**What You Bring**

* Significant leadership experience in one or more of the following areas: data strategy, data management, data products, technology, analytics, transformation, or risk management.
* Experience leading complex, enterprise\-scale data initiatives and operating model change in a matrixed organization.
* A track record of translating strategy into clear priorities, practical roadmaps, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong judgment and the ability to influence, challenge constructively, and build alignment with senior leaders and cross\-functional partners.
* Experience with data governance, data quality, architecture, data products, platform operating models, portfolio planning, or benefits tracking.
* Experience with data technology and product management across major platforms and tools. Familiarity with Rahona, Technology Asset Platform, Databricks, Power BI, or comparable technologies is an asset.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and regulatory or operational pressure while maintaining momentum.
* Inclusive leadership skills and a commitment to creating an environment where people with different backgrounds and perspectives can contribute and succeed.
* Demonstrated emotional intelligence and executive presence, with the ability to listen with curiosity, build trust, navigate sensitive conversations, and bring diverse stakeholders together through complex change.
A post\-secondary degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Advanced education or professional credentials may be an asset but are not required.  
* 

  

We recognize that strong candidates may bring different combinations of education, career paths, and lived experience. We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every qualification listed.
